    def parse_coeff(expr, var):
        expr = expr.replace(" ", "")
        pattern = rf"([+-]?\d*)\*?{var}\b"
        match = re.search(pattern, expr)
        if match:
            coeff_str = match.group(1)
            if coeff_str == "" or coeff_str == "+":
                return 1
            elif coeff_str == "-":
                return -1
            else:
                return int(coeff_str)
        return 0
